Game Overview

In The Bulb Girlfriend 2, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a thrilling 2D platformer adventure in The Bulb Girlfriend 2. Traverse hazardous landscapes and conquer red bulb foes, flying bots, and rotating blades. Master the essential double jump and collect energy potions to dash through escalating challenges, all to reunite with your pink bulb love.
